name: cloudflare
description: Audit Cloudflare zones, run controlled rollouts of rule changes, and interpret Cloudflare semantics. Read-only zone audits (DNS/firewall/cache/rulesets), post-change smoke-test rituals returning GREEN/YELLOW/RED, batched multi-change rollouts, and the semantic decoders that stop you misreading a legacy 'bypass' as a block or an origin 403 as a Cloudflare block. Primarily bosterbio.com.
author: GuildOS
